changelog:
Initial release — expert, brand-neutral rowing machine buying guidance.

- Guides users through key questions on body profile, goals, experience, noise needs, space, and location.
- Recommends structured, prioritized specs (non-negotiable, recommended, optional) based on industry sizing rules.
- Matches user inputs to appropriate resistance types, rail length, weight capacity, and monitor requirements.
- Suggests up to five real rowing machine models that fit the user's confirmed needs.
- Avoids brand or marketing bias; delivers concise, unbiased advice.
